Care Assistant – Nights
Willow Court Care Home, Exeter

Hours: 36 hours per week (3 x 12 hour nights)
Pay: £12.60 per hour
Contract type: Permanent, full time

Must have the right to work in the UK. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship.

What we're looking for:
• A kind, patient approach
• NVQ Level 2 in Health and Social Care (or willingness to work towards it)
• Experience in a care setting is desirable but not essential

Benefits: paid breaks, free parking, £300 refer-a-friend bonus.
